description: This file contains socket helper functions for testing, including socket creation, binding, listening, accepting, connecting, and data transfer functions, as well as utility functions for socket address analysis and test name generation.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: A wrapper class for socket operations, providing methods like IsValid, SetReuseAddress, Bind, Listen, Connect, Accept, SendTo, ReceiveFrom, and IsPending.

classes.name: ConnectedTrio
classes.description: A data structure holding three sockets: listen, client, and server, representing a connected socket trio.

classes.name: ConnectedTrioWrapped
classes.description: A wrapper class for ConnectedTrio, managing socket objects with RAII semantics.

methods.name: GetPortNumberForTests
methods.description: Returns a port number for testing, initializing it once by creating a listening socket.

methods.name: IsUnspecified
methods.description: Checks if a socket address is unspecified (all zeros).

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if a socket address refers to localhost (127.0.0.1 or ::1).

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket with reuse address option enabled.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket wrapped in a Socket class with reuse address enabled.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to a specified port.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class to a specified port.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a TCP socket.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class.

methods.name: CreateConnectingTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket and connects to localhost:<port>.

methods.name: CreateConnectingTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket wrapped in a Socket class and connects to localhost:<port>.

methods.name: AcceptBySpinning
methods.description: Accepts a connection on a server socket by spinning until a connection is accepted or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WriteBySpinning
methods.description: Writes data to a socket by spinning until all data is sent or timeout occurs.

methods.name: ReadBySpinning
methods.description: Reads data from a socket by spinning until all data is received or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Transfer
methods.description: Transfers data between sockets, handling partial sends/receives and pending errors.

methods.name: CreateAndConnect
methods.description: Creates a listening socket, a connecting socket, and accepts a connection, returning a trio of sockets.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectWrapped
methods.description: Creates a listening socket, a connecting socket, and accepts a connection, returning a wrapped trio of sockets.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Measures the time taken for a socket waiter to complete.

methods.name: TimedWaitTimed
methods.description: Measures the time taken for a socket waiter to complete with a timeout.
